formula_clarification.user_resolution: Use payment-affected checkpoints for the actual maximum

metric_definitions.date_exact: includes both missing; no arbitrary day penalty for presence mismatch
metric_definitions.date_tolerances: paired present dates only, inclusive tolerance; includes exact paired matches
metric_definitions.estimator_date_comparison: presence-match first, then finite absolute day error
metric_definitions.normalized_error: absolute safe-amount error / positive requested amount
metric_definitions.row_improvement: both capacity errors no worse and at least one better; tradeoffs reported separately
metric_definitions.safe_relative_error: absolute error / nonzero labeled safe amount

monotonicity: With exogenous fixed flows and a fixed request horizon, delaying a fixed payment cannot lower any checkpoint balance. Recurring obligations do not invalidate this. Search remains sequential; no binary search.
